text:
kai: Heads up: I walked through the quickstart-lite flow after accepting our org SSO invite and clicking the ToS. The example UI just shows a tiny 'Request failed (403)' toast and nothing else.

kai: Browser console has: `{"error":"workspace_billing_required","reason":"no_billing"}` but users won't see that.

onboard-bot: Hi @kai – new workspaces must attach a billing method before hosted endpoints are enabled. Add billing here: https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/abx123/billing :credit_card:

olivia: thanks for filing. Which auth path did you use? Browser OAuth or local service key?

kai: browser OAuth via Okta. I accepted invite -> ToS -> landed on sample page -> clicked "Run demo" -> instant 403. We later attached billing and retried, but initial UX is confusing.

marco: short-term: devs can run the quickstart with a service key to bypass gating: `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_live_xxx` then start dev server.

marco: curl example that works with a service key:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood-mini","input":"hello"}'
```

olivia: good. long-term fix proposals: (1) map the backend code `workspace_billing_required` to a persistent banner/modal with CTA to the workspace billing page, (2) server add `x-redwood-why: billing_required` header so non-JS clients detect this without parsing body, (3) emit telemetry event `onboard.brv.billing_missing` so DX can monitor frequency.

kai: also please add a one-liner in the quickstart README: "If you accept an SSO invite before a billing method is attached you may see a 403 on first requests; attach billing or use a service API key for local testing."

marco: I'll open a tiny PR to quickstart-lite to handle the error mapping + banner. ETA end of day tomorrow.

docs-bot: Created docs task DOC-901: "Add SSO-invite vs billing note to onboarding guide" assigned to @olivia.

olivia: Also, make the error copy actionable: include a direct link and a brief note about how long it takes after attaching billing (couple mins). That reduces support noise.

marco: I'll include that in the PR and add a retry button that re-checks the endpoint once billing is attached.

kai: great — re-tested with the service key workaround and unblocked my testing. Leaving thread open until PR + docs merge.

olivia: I'll also ask support to surface the raw error payload when users file tickets (so we can see the code).

marco: filed starter PR #622 and infra ticket INF-525 to add header + telemetry. Will post links here when available.

kai: thanks everyone. This one felt like a small fix that will save a lot of confusion for new teams.
